toolCalls.input:
{"title":"Fix invoice totals off by one cent","brief":"Owner report: some invoice totals are off by a cent. Requested result: totals are correct to the cent for every line, the change is built and verified.

Likely cause (verify, do not assume): src/invoices/index.ts `lineTotalCents` does `Math.floor(line.unitPrice * 100) * line.quantity`. Binary floating point makes prices like 0.29, 1.15, 4.35, 19.99 multiply to x.9999999, and Math.floor drops a cent (e.g. 0.29 * 100 = 28.999999999999996 -> 28).

What to do:
1. Reproduce first: add failing unit tests in src/invoices/index.test.ts for prices known to trigger it (0.29, 1.15, 4.35, 8.20, 19.99, etc., with several quantities) and a multi-line invoice. Also check the Invoices page via tests/browser/invoices.spec.ts if a page-level case is useful.
2. Fix so line and invoice totals are always exact integer cents. Convert the price to cents with rounding (not floor/truncation) and make sure the result is an integer even for fractional quantities (round the line total to the nearest cent, half away from zero). Keep the existing exported API (`Line`, `lineTotalCents`, `invoiceTotalCents`, `invoiceDate`) unchanged.
3. Look for any other place that does money arithmetic in floats (e.g. src/web/server.ts display `(total / 100).toFixed(2)`) and confirm it is correct; fix if not.
4. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry (CI `npm run check:changelog` requires one).
5. Run `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run test:browser`; all must pass. Fix any unrelated flaky or failing test you find.

Report: the root cause confirmed, the failing-before/passing-after test cases, and the check results.

Conventions: dates in the UI are DD/MM/YYYY. Never run scripts/owner-only.sh.","type":"fix","goalId":null,"now":true,"after":[],"needs":[],"fixed":{},"source":"owner-request"}

{"title":"Add CSV export to the customers page","brief":"Owner request: add a CSV export to the customers page. Requested result: a working export the owner can use from the Customers page, built, tested and shown running.

Context: src/web/server.ts serves the Customers page (table of Name, VAT) from `customers()` in src/customers/index.ts (records: id, name, vat, createdAt ISO string; data in $SANDBOX_DATA_DIR/customers.json).

What to build:
1. A download endpoint that returns all customers as CSV: `Content-Type: text/csv; charset=utf-8`, `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="customers.csv"`. Columns: Name, VAT, Created (createdAt formatted DD/MM/YYYY - owner's date convention). Header row first. Decide whether to include id; keep it simple and useful.
   - Watch out: the router uses `request.url?.startsWith('/customers')`, so a path like /customers.csv would be swallowed by the HTML page. Route it explicitly (e.g. /customers/export.csv or /api/customers.csv) and handle it before the page match.
2. Correct CSV encoding (RFC 4180): quote fields containing comma, quote, CR or LF; double embedded quotes; CRLF line endings. Prefix a UTF-8 BOM so Excel opens accented names correctly. Neutralise spreadsheet formula injection: fields starting with =, +, -, @, tab or CR get a leading single quote.
3. Put the CSV building in a small pure function (e.g. in src/customers) with unit tests covering quoting, newlines, unicode, formula injection, empty list, date format.
4. Add an "Export CSV" link/button on the Customers page (text label, no emoji), styled consistently with the page. Works when there are zero customers (header-only file).
5. Browser test in tests/browser/customers.spec.ts: click the export, assert the download filename and content.
6. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry (CI `npm run check:changelog` requires one).
7. Run `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run test:browser`; all must pass. Fix any unrelated failing or flaky test you see.
8. Start the app as a managed app with jevellan_app_start (seed a few customers, including one with a comma and an accented name), verify the export in the browser, and return the verified browser link.

Sequenced after the invoice-totals fix because both edit CHANGELOG.md; rebase on its result if needed. Never run scripts/owner-only.sh.","type":"feature","goalId":null,"now":true,"after":["task_deaf3aeeb174b9cd6ebdc2d2b4336c889f1bca98"],"needs":[],"fixed":{},"source":"owner-request"}
